A common path is to begin in psychology or education, earn a master's degree in school psychology, complete internships and certification, enter primary or secondary schools, and advance to senior practitioner or regional supervisor.
This career suits careful, composed, patient people willing to work with families. If you value the gradual process of seeing a child regain stability, you can build a stable career.

paragraphs: In the morning, assess a student suspected of ADHD and review attention patterns on rating scales. At noon, align classroom observations with the homeroom teacher and set a behavior contract. In the afternoon, meet with parents to discuss support at home and reduce conflict. Before leaving, write the assessment report and flag severe cases for referral.
